challenge.result: No second dependency or subsystem change passed the proven-improvement gate in this run.
rejected: Do not add sccache while native compilation is not a measured Ferrum bottleneck.
Do not make Perfetto, DuckDB, Zstd, Testcontainers, Crashpad, k6, nsjail or Sigstore mandatory until an isolated same-workload experiment proves value.
Do not change the currently verified browser/Appium/desktop paths merely to adopt a newer ecosystem project.

nextExperiments: Perfetto first: prototype an optional queryable trace sidecar for one existing browser or Android workload and measure capture/query overhead plus agent-call reduction.
Then Testcontainers: prove a disposable service/API fixture through launch, readiness, interaction, logs, cleanup and evidence without affecting ordinary targets.
Prototype a compact in-toto-inspired provenance sidecar linking source SHA, packaged artifact digest, runtime identity and evidence manifest digest.
After a disposable crash fixture exists, evaluate Crashpad minidump capture without changing normal desktop/Electron launches.
nextResearchCursor: remote device/browser labs and self-hosted runner orchestration
macOS/iOS native automation and accessibility control
hybrid WebView deep-DOM diagnostics and protocol differential testing
artifact deduplication/delta storage and long-term evidence retention
cross-browser WebDriver BiDi conformance gaps that affect Ferrum observability
guardrails: No target-count caps, viewport-only shortcuts, reduced evidence, stale caching, weakened assertions, skipped real-runtime proof, or hidden fallback.
Optional ecosystem adapters remain additive until identical-workload evidence proves improvement.
Raw Ferrum evidence stays authoritative even when derived indexes, standardized reports, compressed archives, traces, provenance or signatures are added.
